runtime.description: The HoMM3 Dungeon rules the underworld through troglodytes, harpies, beholders, medusas, minotaurs, manticores, and dragons. Overlords and warlocks favor intimidation, underground wealth, brutal monsters, and black dragon supremacy.

allowedDebt: Dungeon is basic-enabled. Source plugin unit import rows, bundles, static portraits, preview manifests, lab sidecars, hero portraits, faction art, city billboard art, dwelling billboard frames, runtime registry rows, and generic release Core output are present.

Dungeon still uses suffix upgrade SIDs such as h3_red_dragon_upg in the game-facing payload contract. Source-exact upgrade names such as h3_black_dragon and h3_shadow_dragon remain schema debt and should be converted across manifest variantSids, import rows, portraits, Core rows, and runtime mirrors together.

Native Dungeon Triumvirate's Strength filters are unverified for homm3_dungeon. The scaffold reserves skill_faction_homm3_dungeon instead of reusing skill_faction_dungeon until static tracing proves the native filters are safe.
